transitions.logic: Fresh yellow-green edges consolidate into celadon groups; keep warm mineral support pale and let structural ink increase locally.
Carry celadon into humid blue-gray ground; deepen grouped vegetation while retaining a light receiving passage.
Increase cool grouped cores and mineral depth, with warm olive/amber openings rather than green over every terrain surface.
Use the existing amber opening as the hinge into straw/copper; make Autumn's structural color shift assertive, retaining cool mineral counterweights.
Copper peaks retreat into dry mauve/umber-neutral structure; break accent territories and expose more paper and rock.
Desaturate warm mineral remnants toward cold gray; shift emphasis from canopy color to selected trunks, joints and ground contacts.
Reduce colored path weight and dark-ink incidence while retaining a few warm remnants; preserve P8's gentle ending and long rest.
